name: LoCoMo-Plus
ontology_notes: Real public dataset and harness. Extends LoCoMo with a sixth Cognitive category. Cue-trigger pairs are generated from scratch, human-filtered, then stitched into LoCoMo trajectories under cue-trigger semantic disconnect. Cognitive memory is decomposed into causal, state, goal, and value constraints. Unified eval uses constraint consistency and an LLM judge (correct=1, partial=0.5, wrong=0), without disclosing task type. GitHub ships locomo_plus.json plus locomo10.json. ACL 2026 long paper 2026.acl-long.1150.

supersession.evidence: Cognitive cases apply a latent constraint. They do not score overwriting an old biographical fact with a newer one.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Each cue-query pair has a temporal gap indicator t. Triggers are specified as at least one week or months later in the generation prompt (paper appendix). Still not a companion time-skip reunion.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Same two-speaker LoCoMo chats plus inserted cues. No character vs user vs relationship vs lore types.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: The exam-prep vs TV-series example requires not recommending a distraction. That is constraint-consistent behavior, closer to social timing than fact F1. It is still not trauma, kink, spoiler, or 'do not recall this'.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No stored-memory jailbreak or persona overwrite cases. Limitations section says the bench does not model multi-agent memory or long-term belief revision.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: No forget-that items in the six categories (LoCoMo five plus Cognitive).
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Scores are judge consistency and the LoCoMo-to-Plus gap. Figure 7 studies length sensitivity. No tokens-per-turn cost.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Public GitHub pipeline. No LICENSE file in the repo listing. Judge and generation default to OpenAI-compatible APIs.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Would slightly prefer systems that apply implicit user constraints when the later query does not look like the cue. That is closer to companion social memory than LoCoMo F1. It would not select for character identity, poisoning, forget, or RP lore.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo-Plus
published_eval.claimed_score: Paper Table 1. Cognitive column is LoCoMo-Plus. gemini-2.5-pro 26.06 with factual average 71.78 (gap 45.72). gpt-4o 21.05 vs 62.99. Mem0 15.80 vs factual 57.24 (gap 41.44). A-Mem 17.20 vs 59.64. All methods stay low on cognitive.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether a later response stays consistent with an implicit causal, state, goal, or value constraint planted earlier, when the trigger is semantically distant from the cue. Also reruns LoCoMo's five factual types under the unified judge.

open_unknowns: Exact count of cognitive instances is not stated as a single number in the paper HTML. GitHub README does not print N. Third-party blogs citing 401 are not used.
